description: Builds analytics tables and views on SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Fabric from DuckDB-dialect SQL: plan, then apply.
notes: The server's state database is a SQLite file in its data directory (the 'service' topology, no setup); for a database shared by a group or the install see: dbdatabuild state init. The server is a Windows service (dbdatabuild service install, from an elevated prompt) that runs 'server run' with the data directory %ProgramData%\DbDataKit\build, where its identity, paired clients, project list and certificate live. It starts hosting no project: add the folder of each with: dbdatabuild server project add <id> --path <folder> (or --git <address>). Pair a console with it: dbdatabuild server pair --max-role admin. The command line itself needs no service and works on its own in any project folder.
